name: Seated Wide-Grip Row (Cable)
instructions: Sit at the cable row with a wide-grip bar and your feet on the platform.
Pull the bar to your upper abdomen, flaring your elbows.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A seated cable row with a wide grip that emphasises the upper back.
